newsitem.title: UK: Jardine Pacific runs ads to reassure Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Jardine Pacific runs ads to reassure Hong Kong.

text.p: Jardine Pacific, the trading and services arm of Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd, is running a TV advertising campaign in Hong Kong to reassure locals that it intends to remain in the colony when it reverts to Chinese rule in 1997, according to a report in the Wall Street Journal on Monday.
The message behind the campaign, says Jardine Pacific's managing director Blair Pickerell, is that "At a time when lots of things in Hong Kong are changing, we're not."
Pickerell said the ads were intended to overcome public perceptions about the company.
"I think there were some doubts among a reasonable number of people in Hong Kong as to our commitment to Hong Kong," he told the newspaper.
TV ads will be shown on English- and Chinese-language channels and a newspaper campaign will also run in both English- and Chinese-language publications.
Jardine Pacific is involved in a number of industries including shipping, property, construction and information technology.
